Equine rehabilitation services in Oklahoma featuring equine treadmill, laser therapy, shockwave therapy, massage therapy, coldwater spa, equine cryotherapy and peak performance conditioning.

Mobile equine rehab services for the Oklahoma City area, we’ll come to your barn or to the show when you need us. 

Post injury and post surgical recovery from certified technicians. 

Located at Rein Maker Ranch and lead by equine experts who understand healing horses, restoring performance and caring for horse injuries.

Give your horse the competitive edge with expert-led conditioning and recovery therapies that build muscle, improve stamina, and prevent injuries—without the wear and tear.
